evals.name: competitor-set-validation
evals.prompt: we've got a new client, spamedica.com â€” toronto med spa. client gave us their competitor list: drpirani.com, drdavidboudana.com, torontosurgery.com, torontoplasticsurgeon.com, drtorgerson.com. can you sanity check that set before I build the gap analysis on it? something feels off but I can't put my finger on it
evals.expected_output: Reports observed overlap when available, otherwise marks it unknown; qualifies competitor-set hypotheses with actual evidence.
assertions: Does not invent overlap counts or client category facts
Uses supplied live SERP evidence when available
Explains competitor exclusions and entity coverage

evals.name: page-level-link-earning
evals.prompt: for razer.com's competitors (corsair.com, logitech.com, steelseries.com) â€” I want to know which of their PAGES pull the most links and what's actually earning those links. not domain level stuff, page level. what content should we be building?
evals.expected_output: Uses DataSiteTopPageList sorted by root_domains_to_page, skips the homepage, pulls links to the standout pages, names the tactic behind each, and checks the follow/nofollow split.
assertions: Sorts top pages by referring domains rather than page authority
Excludes or discounts the homepage row
Names a specific replicable content tactic tied to an identified page
Checks anchor uniformity or follow/nofollow split on at least one page

evals.name: full-run-workbook
evals.prompt: full backlink gap analysis for spamedica.com vs drtorgerson.com and torontosurgery.com, canadian market. need the workbook at the end with the scored targets tab filled in
evals.expected_output: An .xlsx with tabs 1-5 plus S1 and P1-P3, Score and Decision as live formulas, Summary counts, and flags recorded.
assertions: Produces an .xlsx containing all ten expected tabs
Score and Decision are Excel formulas, not hardcoded values
Summary counts derive from COUNTIF over the Decision column
A high-DA but irrelevant domain scores below the Pursue threshold
The link network is recorded as a flag rather than as an opportunity

evals.name: integrity-regressions
evals.prompt: Build the packaged synthetic example, then test a partial competitor set, unresolved recent link, duplicate publisher opportunities and an execution override.
evals.expected_output: Offline regression suite passes; workbook, markdown and normalized JSON agree.
assertions: Unverified recent row is Verify first
Missing competitor coverage fails full build
Partial reports retain reasons and entity fractions
Unique domains differ from opportunity counts
Product claims are sourced from approved input only
